Under the planned change only GLOSSARY.md:304 and README.md:570 break (their reviewer wording is rewritten, and no test or gate compares it, so both are unguarded); every reader, checker and hook registration found stays green, while the present-tense restatements in the review, execute and settle-change skills contradict the new wording until those skills change.

GLOSSARY.md:304 says the review gate is run by fresh subagents, one per concern, that never see the implementor's reasoning; README.md:570-571 says /afk:review fans out fresh subagents, one per concern. Both restate the review skill's spawn rule: one fresh subagent per concern (skills/afk/review/SKILL.md:12), all spawned in one message through the active harness's general review role (skills/afk/review/SKILL.md:43).

The general review role of skills/afk/review/SKILL.md:43 is the Generic role row of PROVIDERS.md:24 (a general-purpose role on one harness, a built-in worker role on the other); how a harness starts that subagent is harness runtime outside this repository (B14).

No gate compares the reviewer wording of GLOSSARY.md:304 or README.md:570-571, and 'pane-agent workers' trips none; but native-contract rule A checks more than five token rules: over every plugin .md but PROVIDERS.md, CAPABILITIES.md and providers/CONFORMANCE.md (hooks/native-contract-gate.sh:78-81) it also requires an inline fallback on every CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (hooks/native-contract-gate.sh:121-127), which neither line nor the planned wording names. Skill-registry check B needs only every skill named in README.md (hooks/skill-registry-gate.sh:124); the wiring gate reads only added files and skips both names (hooks/wiring-gate.sh:34, :105); the release gate opens neither (hooks/release-gate.sh:74-84).

The genericity gate scans the added lines of every changed plugin .md (hooks/genericity-gate.sh:156, dispatched at hooks/stop-gates.sh:133) and exits 2 on a ticket-shaped token whose prefix is not notation (hooks/genericity-gate.sh:247-251, hooks/lib/sensitive-patterns.tsv:8-9): 'pane-agent workers', S-160, AC-045 and ADR-0013 pass, but writing DOC-1, INV-018 or TR-1 into either line would block the Stop.

scripts/glossary_usage.py opens GLOSSARY.md (scripts/glossary_usage.py:130, :135) and checks only that each **Term** heading and its _Also_ forms have a consumer file (scripts/glossary_usage.py:23, :82-93); the live test scripts/tests/test_glossary_usage.py:160-174 pins that, and /afk:setup audit check 6 states it (skills/afk/setup/AUDIT.md:79). Nothing compares the entry body at GLOSSARY.md:304, and removing README.md:570-571 leaves no heading without a consumer.

The tooltip hook makes GLOSSARY.md:304 the hover text for 'review gate' on rendered pages: it reads the plugin GLOSSARY.md (hooks/lavish-tips.sh:66, :70, :208), keys each heading lower-cased (hooks/lavish-tips.sh:126, :161), and parses the feature's LAVISH-TIPS.md last (hooks/lavish-tips.sh:263), so its kind-neutral 'review gate' entry (docs/afk/agent-team-topology/LAVISH-TIPS.md:21) wins on this feature's pages. Only hooks/tests/hook-smoke.sh:119 runs the hook, on a non-render command, so no test pins the tooltip text.

A dashboard legend built from the plugin GLOSSARY.md (skills/afk/mission-control/DIGEST-FORMAT.md:188) is not marked stale when GLOSSARY.md:304 changes, because the plugin glossary is deliberately outside the digest's freshness inputs (skills/afk/mission-control/DIGEST-FORMAT.md:40-44); it shows the old wording until rebuilt. No legend exists in this repository, so the ones in consuming repositories are not checked (B14).

Unconditional wording ('the review runs pane-agent workers') would be false whenever no pane transport is found or the switch is set back, because role agents then run as subagents (docs/afk/agent-team-topology/PRD.md:141, :144; docs/afk/agent-team-topology/GRILL-LOG.md:462); the two lines need that condition, or a pointer to the one home the pane-agent rule gets (docs/afk/agent-team-topology/PRD.md:147).

Deployment order: the two lines ship in the same change as the review's spawn steps, or after them (decision at docs/afk/agent-team-topology/GRILL-LOG.md:460); shipped first, they contradict the skills that still start reviewers as subagents (skills/afk/review/SKILL.md:12, :43, :146, :195; skills/afk/review/SETTLEMENT.md:8, :17; skills/afk/execute/SKILL.md:71).
